A14: the roll preview, revised

B14 keeps "Taint Rank 4 × 2 (Lost)" after its total, as you approved. Wounds has a level name, "Nicked", to stand for the figure. Jigoku has none, so its short sum does that job.

B02: the case for keeping it

I can't give you three strong reasons. The best case, strongest first:

  1. The row doesn't say its cost includes a discount. Social Position shows 4 where the book says 6, and the reason is on another card, Blissful Betrothal's. Your "remind, not remember" rule leans this way. Moderate: you set Blissful Betrothal up yourself, and its note says exactly which entries it changes.
  2. Checking the XP total against the book, for example by a GM. Weak: Blissful Betrothal's note and Large's Crab-price note already answer it.
  3. Consistency, your note of 8 October (FT-13): Clan prices have a note, but Blissful Betrothal's four don't. Weak: dropping B02 leaves this as it is today, and it misleads no one.
Recommendation: drop B02. Nothing is built for it. Today's notes stay exactly as they are: Large's "Crab price: 3 XP (catalogue 4)." (with "— fixed when you leave Management." while the price is provisional), "Cost set by hand…", "Fixed when bought…", and Blissful Betrothal's own note.

Kharmic Tie: one row

Test character: a Kharmic Tie at Rank 3, tied to Aiko, with one use spent this session (2 of 3 left). No Blissful Betrothal. The same character in Play and in Manage.

WhatProposed
The rowThe person and the Rank once, in the badge ("Aiko · Rank 3"); then the pips and Reset session; then Change (Manage only) and one i. It is one line on a laptop, and one line on a phone in Play. The Rank stays in the badge because the cost box doesn't always show it (with Blissful Betrothal, Rank 3 costs 1).
GoesThe line "Target: Aiko — Rank 3; 2/3 uses remaining" (the badge and the pips say it); the i inside the badge ("The chosen person for this Kharmic Tie"); and the i after Reset session ("Restore this advantage to its per-session maximum").
The one iThe rule in a sentence, each use (+1k1), the uses left in words, and what Reset session and Change do. The sheet records no page for Kharmic Tie, so the build adds one from a rules check.
StaysWhat Reset session and Change do; the roll preview's offer on attack rolls ("nothing is spent until you roll"); the pips' spoken label ("2 of 3 Kharmic Tie uses remaining"); the cost box; an unconfigured Tie's "Choose…" button.
ElsewhereLuck, Unlucky, Dark Paragon, the Ancestor card and the once-per-session entries each have the same Reset session with its own i. This card is the first use of your A04.2 row pattern (badge, Change, one i). A04.2 brings the others in line when it is unparked; they are not changed here.
Not changedThe empty Description box, which takes the most room on this card in Play. Hiding it when it is empty would be a separate small unit.
Recommendation: approve as shown, as a fifth group-1 unit, B17 — One Row for Kharmic Tie (marker PART H PHASE 15.2.5), screen-only. It is what you described: one Change, one i, the pips and Reset, with the person named once.

  2. B02: drop (recommended), or keep as first shown.
  3. Kharmic Tie's card: approve as shown, as a fifth group-1 unit (recommended), revise, or drop.

A14 · your note on check W2.3, 8 October · Q1

Explain the Wound penalty once

Your two-entry example: Low Pain Threshold (Disadvantage) and Strength of the Earth (Advantage) together, the character Nicked. Earth 2, campaign multiplier 2, 12 of 38 wound points. You wrote that the sum was right but confusing: Nicked's own 3, then +5 and −3, net +5.

The Wounds line on the Combat page

The roll preview

Quick Access

WhatProposed
ChangesThe Wounds line, each level's name for screen readers, the window a level opens, Quick Access and the roll preview's Wound Penalty row: one figure each, and the sum behind the i or after the dash.
StaysThe arithmetic and its floors (Low Pain Threshold +5 on every rank with a penalty, Healthy stays at none; Strength of the Earth −3, never below none); the thresholds; Bad Health and Permanent Wound, which change thresholds rather than penalties, and keep their notes on their cards.
No entriesA character without these entries sees no change, because the line already shows one number. The i appears only when an entry changes the penalty.
Recommendation: approve A14 as shown. The figure you play with comes first, everywhere it appears. The sum is one tap away and starts from the rank's own penalty, so +3, +5 and −3 add up on screen.
B02 · FT-13, your note of 8 October · Q1

Actual and catalogue price, the same way on every row

Test character: Blissful Betrothal with "Your Kharmic Tie is to your spouse" ticked; Social Position (catalogue 6); a Kharmic Tie at Rank 3 (3); Large at the Crab price (catalogue 4, Crab 3, Core Rulebook p.151). Manage, Advantages.

WhatProposed
RowsEvery price another entry changes. That covers the Clan, family and School-type prices (39 entries, Feature 4.5.25) and Blissful Betrothal's four (Gentry, a Kharmic Tie to your spouse, Social Position, Wealthy). A row changed by both lists both, in the order applied. A Disadvantage worth more to a Clan reads the same way.
NumbersRead from the sheet's price engines, never worked out again here. Prices are as they are today.
StaysThe note for a cost you typed ("Cost set by hand. Book price: …"), the note for a price fixed when bought that the book has since changed ("Fixed when bought: …"), and Blissful Betrothal's own note on its card. Each of these says something different from the new line.
WhereWhere today's Clan note shows: under the row, in Manage and in Play.
Recommendation: approve B02 as shown. You can see at a glance which costs are discounted and by how much. The reason, with its page, is one tap away, in the same form for every kind of discount.
B04 · FT-20 · Q8

Blind's line under Armor TN

Test character: Blind (Disadvantage), Reflexes 2, no armour. Blind's base is Reflexes + 5 = 7, not Reflexes × 5 + 5 (Core Rulebook p.156). Play, Combat page.

WhatProposed
BreakdownThe base (Blind: Reflexes + 5 with its page, or Reflexes × 5 + 5), the Armor TN Bonus with the armour's name, then each other bonus in effect, by name: stance, a Void Point, two weapons, Way of the Dragon, Shiba's gift, Weakness. Then the total. The scratch version groups the others into one row; this character has none.
Without BlindThe same breakdown, with the base "Reflexes 3 × 5 + 5". Quick Access's i is there for every character.
StaysEvery number; the Combat card's Blind line; the Initiative part of the Combat window.
Recommendation: approve B04 as shown. Quick Access keeps the figure you play with. The whole sum is one tap away and is correct for Blind, which the Combat window's formula is not today.
B14 · the A01–A16 device round's Lost wording · Q8

Jigoku's total, then its arithmetic

Test character: Touch of the Spirit Realms (Jigoku) with Lost ticked, Taint Rank 4. The Advantage adds your Taint Rank to attack rolls and to rolls using a Physical Trait, twice when Lost (Core Rulebook pp.154–155). Shown: a Defense roll (Reflexes) and the card in Play. As you approved, this stays in 15b. It is not a resisting row.

WhatProposed
WordingLost: "+8 to total — Taint Rank 4 × 2 (Lost)", and on the card "Adding +8 — Taint Rank 4 × 2 (Lost)." Not Lost: "+4 to total — Taint Rank 4", and "Adding +4 — Taint Rank 4." Built from your current Taint Rank and the Lost tick, never fixed numbers.
StaysThe formula and when it applies (attack rolls and Physical-Trait rolls); Taint Rank 0 adds nothing and keeps its flag; the Lost tick. Cursed by the Realm (Jigoku), the Disadvantage, is not touched: its penalty is a resisting row, left for the resistance phase.
Recommendation: approve B14 as shown. It is the same pattern as A14's preview row: the amount, then the sum from your values.
